transportLinkId.description: Unique identifier of this transport link within its owning system.
transportLinkId.title: ObjectId

typeId.description: Unique identifier for a transport link type (SCOOT, ANPR, SCOOT Entry, ...).
typeId.title: TypeId

creationDate.description: When this definition record was created.

location.description: Start of the transport link as a WGS84 point. Optional.

endPoint.description: End of the transport link as a WGS84 point. Optional here although the v1 XSD requires it, matching transport_route.

shortDescription.description: Short human-readable name (e.g. 'A1 northbound, Jct 5 -> Jct 6').

participantId.description: System that owns this transport link definition. Often implicit from context.
participantId.title: ParticipantId

originatingParticipantId.description: Identifier of the upstream system that originally created this object (comparable to the UML DataSourceTypeId).
originatingParticipantId.title: ParticipantId

originatingObjectId.description: Identifier of this object on the originating (upstream) system. Enables cross-system traceability.
originatingObjectId.title: ObjectId

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
